marketLayer.title: US Tech & AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology conglomerates reported sustained high artificial intelligence capital expenditure alongside resilient cloud infrastructure revenue growth.
marketLayer.inference: Persistent enterprise AI demand provides a strong foundation for broad tech sector valuations, sustaining bullish momentum across the Nasdaq and S&P 500.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Risk of margin compression if monetization of AI services lags behind aggressive infrastructure expenditure.

marketLayer.title: HK Internet & Consumer Tech Inflows
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index experienced positive momentum driven by strong Southbound capital inflows and resilient Q2 performance metrics from major platform enterprise giants.
marketLayer.inference: Historically low valuation multiples combined with improving earnings fundamentals are incentivizing institutional long-term allocation into HK-listed tech heavyweights.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Domestic consumer spending recovery trajectory in mainland China and potential macro policy execution delays.

marketLayer.title: US Federal Reserve Monetary Policy & Treasury Yields
marketLayer.fact: US 10-year Treasury yields shifted lower following macro economic indicators pointing to a gradual labor market cooling and moderate inflation metrics.
marketLayer.inference: An anticipated monetary easing cycle enhances global liquidity conditions, lowering cost of capital and offering macro tailwinds for both US growth stocks and Hong Kong equity valuations.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Unexpected inflation sticky points driven by geopolitical trade friction or supply chain disruptions.
